title: Malaysia
subtitle: Melaka’s river streets, Kuala Lumpur’s towers and cave temples, Penang’s painted lanes and forest paths, and the ridges and mangroves of Langkawi.

cover.alt: Langkawi’s curved SkyBridge suspended between steep forested ridges, seen from above.
cover.caption: Langkawi’s curved SkyBridge suspended between steep forested ridges, seen from above.

chapters.title: An evening in Melaka
paragraphs: Red arcades and decorated trishaws lead down to the river. As daylight fades, coloured reflections take over the water and Jonker Walk lights up.

chapters.title: The old city in morning light
paragraphs: The river is quieter in the morning. The walk continues past small shrines and timber roofs, up to St Paul’s stone walls and back down to the fort gateway and waterfront.

chapters.title: Towers, trees and evening streets
paragraphs: The twin towers rise above fountains and green park paths. A traditional timber house offers a quieter stop before the lanterns, food stalls and crowds of Bukit Bintang.

chapters.title: A morning through George Town
paragraphs: The day begins on the ferry and continues through breakfast, temple streets and painted walls. At the clan jetties, timber houses stand above green water and small boats rest beside the walkways.

chapters.title: Forest paths beside the sea
paragraphs: The afternoon follows the coastal paths of Penang National Park: sandy coves, rounded rocks and roots crossing the trail. The sea turns grey towards evening, followed by a simple dinner on the north coast.

chapters.title: Above the city on Penang Hill

chapters.title: The eagle at the waterfront
paragraphs: The first stop on Langkawi is the waterfront square, where a broad-winged eagle faces the open sky.

chapters.title: Across the ridges of Langkawi
paragraphs: Cable cars climb above the forest to views of the coastline and scattered islands. The SkyBridge curves between steep green ridges; closer to the ground, steps wind between roots and trunks.

chapters.title: Mangroves and limestone waterways
paragraphs: Small boats wait at the jetty before the route enters the mangroves. A cave entrance, tangled roots and narrow channels lead towards broader water and forested limestone cliffs.
